listing.name: Ben 10: Omniverse — Ben10OmniverseRecomp (andrebrumdev)
listing.summary: The project reports startup, logos and video, with 27–59 FPS measured on an M5 Air. Exact mission coverage is unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BLUS31017 version 01.00 disc, decrypted EBOOT and assets.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow build_macos.sh and run_ben10.sh to generate and build the game code locally.
